'''Seabirds''' were [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|birds]] that live primarily on the surface of a body of [[Water/Legends|water]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] with an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] environment were often populated by seabirds and other marine lifeforms.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
